def any_int(x, y, z):
    # Check if all numbers are integers (no decimal part)
    if not isinstance(x, int) or not isinstance(y, int) or not isinstance(z, int):
        return False
    
    # Check if one number equals the sum of the other two
    return x == y + z or y == x + z or z == x + y

# Examples:
print(any_int(5, 2, 7))   # True (5+2=7)
print(any_int(3, 2, 2))   # False
print(any_int(3, -2, 1))  # True (-2+1=-1? No. But 3 + (-2) = 1 → True)
print(any_int(3.6, -2.2, 2)) # False (not all integers)

def any_int(x, y, z):
    # Check if all numbers are integers (no decimal part)
    if not isinstance(x, int) or not isinstance(y, int) or not isinstance(z, int):
        return False
    
    # Check if one number equals the sum of the other two
    return x == y + z or y == x + z or z == x + y

# Examples:
print(any_int(5, 2, 7))   # True (5+2=7)
print(any_int(3, 2, 2))   # False
print(any_int(3, -2, 1))  # True (-2+1=-1? No. But 3 + (-2) = 1 → True)
print(any_int(3.6, -2.2, 2)) # False (not all integers)
